---
title: "S6 - Targets and leakage audit"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/00_utils/notebook_setup.R")
```

**Stage:** S6 (targets).
**Purpose:** state the target decision, tabulate event counts per split, and
make the leakage status of the primary target explicit.
**Inputs:** `output/design_audit.csv`.
**Outputs:** none.
**Parameters:** `P$train_years = 1981:2010`, `P$test_years = 2011:2020`.

## Target decision

- **Primary (T1, external SMA):** district soil-moisture anomaly `<= -15%`.
  The product is a percent anomaly computed against its own 1981-2020
  climatology, so test-year targets are *not* strictly leakage-free. This is
  disclosed, not hidden.
- **Leakage-clean sensitivity (T1-strict):** a training-only SPI-3 drought
  target (`spi3 <= -1` standardized on 1981-2010 only), with the matching
  `spi3` predictor dropped to avoid circularity.

```{r}
da <- nb_require("design_audit.csv", "S6")
nb_assert_cols(da,
  c("gauge_id", "n_train", "n_test", "events_sma_train", "events_sma_test",
    "events_spi3_train", "events_spi3_test", "n_spi3_finite",
    "n_ssi3_finite", "n_spei3_finite", "n_queue_finite"),
  "design audit")
nb_assert(all(da$n_train > 0 & da$n_test > 0), "empty train/test split")
nb_assert(all(da$events_sma_train > 0), "a gauge has no training events")
knitr::kable(da[, .(gauge_id, n_train, n_test,
                    ev_sma_tr = events_sma_train, ev_sma_te = events_sma_test,
                    ev_spi3_tr = events_spi3_train, ev_spi3_te = events_spi3_test,
                    spi3 = n_spi3_finite, ssi3 = n_ssi3_finite,
                    queue = n_queue_finite)],
             caption = "Event counts and predictor availability by gauge")
```

## Leakage audit

```{r}
cat(sprintf("gauges: %d\n", nrow(da)))
cat(sprintf("training events (SMA): total %d, median %d per gauge\n",
            sum(da$events_sma_train), as.integer(median(da$events_sma_train))))
cat(sprintf("test events (SMA): total %d, median %d per gauge\n",
            sum(da$events_sma_test), as.integer(median(da$events_sma_test))))
cat(sprintf("predictor availability: spi3 %d, ssi3 %d, spei3 %d, queue %d months\n",
            sum(da$n_spi3_finite), sum(da$n_ssi3_finite),
            sum(da$n_spei3_finite), sum(da$n_queue_finite)))
```

`[measurement]` Every gauge carries both splits and at least one training
event. The primary target touches the 1981-2020 climatology window, which
includes test years; the T1-strict sensitivity (stage S8, target axis) is the
leakage-clean check and is reported alongside, never instead of, the primary.

`[assumption]` An event is a month with the target at or below threshold.
The plan's >= 2-consecutive-month event definition is used for the descriptive
event-timing secondary; the confirmatory endpoints score monthly outcomes.
